title: Guest Towel Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass | Spanish Gold | Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Keep hand towels right where you need them—next to the sink—without drilling into walls in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. The Carolina Collection guest towel stand adds convenient countertop towel storage with a classic, traditional look.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Protect countertop surfaces: Felt pad on the bottom helps prevent scratching
- Coordinate a matched bath: Designed to pair with matching Carolina and other traditional bathroom hardware
- Built for lasting use: Crafted from solid brass construction

Specs:
- Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 16.3 x 14 x 5.5 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 8 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs.
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
